carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Maximum dimensions for cabin baggage are 115 cm (50x40x25cm).

carryon_weight.value: Economy class: one piece of up to 8 kg. Business class: two pieces, the first up to 8 kg and the second up to 4 kg.

personal_item.value: All passengers may also carry 1 personal item free of charge.

size_weight.value: Standard baggage weight is 23 kg; summary dimensions are 158 cm.

max_piece.value: No article is accepted as baggage if it weighs more than 32 kg or measures more than 203 cm (length plus width plus height); heavier baggage must be repacked or sent as cargo.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled

care.value: Under the EU Regulation, when a flight is delayed beyond its scheduled departure by 2 hours (flights up to 1.500 km) or 3 hours (flights between 1.500 km and 3.500 km), passengers are entitled to care: meals and refreshments in reasonable relation to the wait, hotel accommodation with transfers if necessary, and two brief telephone calls, faxes or e-mails.

rebooking.value: If your flight is cancelled, you are entitled to rebooking, re-routing or a refund without any additional charge.

refund.value: If Air Moldova cancels a flight, does not operate it to schedule or causes you to miss a connection: a wholly unused ticket is refunded at the fare paid plus all unused airport taxes; a partly used ticket gets back the unused part of the fare plus all unused airport fees and taxes.

airport_cutoff.value: On all Air Moldova flights check-in opens 3 hours before departure and closes strictly 60 minutes before scheduled departure.

gate_close.value: The gate closes 25 minutes prior to departure (30 minutes at Frankfurt airport).

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard seats, preferred location seats, and extra legroom seating options are available depending on aircraft and cabin class

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a specific seat in advance for a fee or free depending on fare class, or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: Children traveling with an accompanying adult are seated together during advance seat reservation or at check-in
